name: Trade Counterparty Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of the trade counterparty.

BENE.name: Beneficiary
BENE.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is a Beneficiary.

BROK.name: Broker
BROK.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is a Broker.

CLEM.name: Clearing Member
CLEM.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is a Clearing Member.

EXEA.name: Executing Agent
EXEA.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is an Executing Agent.

OTHC.name: Other Counterparty
OTHC.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is an Other Counterparty.

REPC.name: Reporting Counterparty
REPC.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is a Reporting Counterparty.

SBMA.name: Submitting Agent
SBMA.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is a Submitting Agent.

ERFR.name: Entity Responsible For Report
ERFR.definition: Specifies that party to the transaction is an Entity Responsible For Report.
